_note: Mocombe mega-menu hover-preview clips. Keys are the EXACT video paths site-addons.js expects: it maps a page href -> {v:'<sect>/<slug>'} and loads /Images/mega/<sect>/<slug>.mp4 (+ optional .jpg poster). Verified against site-addons.js MAP on 2026-07-20. Do NOT rename these keys to match page filenames - the map is deliberately different (long-term-care.html -> personal/ltc, group-dental-vision.html -> business/group-dv).

_render._why: site-addons.js styles .mega-preview-media at aspect-ratio 4/3, ~280px wide, object-fit:cover. 640x480 is 4:3 and both dims are divisible by 32 as LTX requires. Rendering 16:9 here would get center-cropped and lose the subject.

_style_suffix: cinematic, soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, warm and trustworthy tone, gentle slow-motion, 4k, no text, no logos
